Parc at Caney

Discover the community

A community apart

Room to breathe.
Space to belong.

One of the best luxury communities to call home in Fulton and Forsyth counties, Parc at Caney is a one-of-a-kind collection of just 18 custom luxury homes. Each luxury home has its own character; no two were built alike, creating a collection unlike any other in the Atlanta metro.

✳

Made for living well

A little more room for what matters.

With only 18 luxury homes, Parc at Caney is an intimate neighborhood designed around a sense of space, connection, and home. Each residence is custom built by Epic Homes, with its own character and a design that is never repeated elsewhere in the community.

Off GA-141 · tucked into Caney Creek Preserve

Right off the road.
Wrapped in green.

Enjoy quick access to GA-141, then come home to the lush quiet of Caney Creek Preserve. Parc at Caney brings the convenience of Johns Creek, Cumming, and Alpharetta together with a peaceful, tucked-away setting.
